SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.HORIZONTALCODE, C.INDEXNAME, D.ANALYSISUSERNAME, E.EQUIPTID AS ANALYSISEQUIPTNO, E.EQUIPTNAME AS ANALYSISEQUIPTNAME, H.SAMPLEUSERNAME, H.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYID, H.MONITORPOINTCATEGORY, H.MONITORPOINTNAME AS FOLDERMONITORPOINTNAME, H.PROCESSSTATUS, H.LONGITUDE, H.LATITUDE, G.EQUIPTID AS SAMPLEEQUIPTNO, G.EQUIPTNAME AS SAMPLEEQUIPTNAME, I.REGISTDATE, I.PROJNO, M.TESTMETHODBASIS, A.ITEMALIASNAME AS ITEMGROUP FROM T_EMC_REPORT_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER B ON A.ORDERID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX C ON A.INDEXID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN D ON D.ID = A.RUNID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT E ON E.ID = D.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK F ON F.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT G ON G.ID = F.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER H ON H.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT I ON I.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD M ON M.ID = A.METHODID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
